a) Prove the following identities
 

i) $\displaystyle \frac{1}{1 + \cos\theta} + \frac{1}{1 - \cos\theta} = 2 \csc^2\theta$ **[3marks]**
ii) Solve $(\sin\theta + \cos\theta)^2 + (\sin\theta - \cos\theta)^2 = 2$ **[2marks]**
b) Solve $2 \cos^2 2x = \cos 2x$ 

 Where $0 \le x < 360^\circ$ **[4marks]**

i) Passing through the point $(1, 3)$ and perpendicular to the line whose equation is $3x + 2y - 5 = 0$ **[2marks]**
ii) Passing through the point $(-1, 3)$ and parallel to the line whose equation is $3x - 4y + 2 = 0$. **[2marks]**
iii) Making an intercept of 3 on the $x$-axis and -1 on the $y$-axis. **[2marks]**

 $3x^2 + 3y^2 - 12x + 8y = 9$. **[3marks]**

f) Find an equation of the ellipse with vertices $(\pm 4, 0)$ and foci $(\pm 2, 0)$ **[3 marks]**

g) A hyperbola has vertices $(\pm 3, 0)$ and passes through the point $P(5, 2)$. Find its equation, foci and asymptotes. **[3 marks]**

$$
2 \sin 45^\circ \cos 15^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{5} - 1}{2}
$$

 **[4 marks]**

i) 

$$
1 - \frac{\cos^2 \theta}{1 + \sin \theta} = \sin \theta
$$

 **[4 marks]**

ii) 

$$
\cot \theta + \frac{\sin \theta}{1 + \cos \theta} = \csc \theta
$$

 **[4 marks]**

2. Find the length of the tangent from the point \([7, 10]\) to the circle \((x - 2)^2 + (y - 4)^2 = 7\). **[3mks]**

$$
r=\frac{8}{1+4\cos\theta}.
$$

$$
8x+3y-5=0 \qquad\text{and}\qquad 3x-2y+8=0.
$$

$$
x^2+y^2-3x+2y-3=0 \qquad\text{and}\qquad x^2+y^2+2x+y+1=0
$$

 are orthogonal.

$$
2x^2+2y^2-5x+4y-7=0
$$

$$
\frac{x^2}{9}-\frac{y^2}{16}=1
$$

 at the point \((5,\tfrac{16}{3})\).

(b) Determine the coordinates of the point where this line intersects the $x$-axis.
(c) Find the perpendicular distance from the origin to this line.
